name: zchv4r-hub-home-installed-chain
goal: Hub Home browser tests run in the installed-app configuration, and one chain test (Hub routes, relay, Mac app, Tracker API) fails when a web read, tap, Other, session note or View spec does not reach the Tracker

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Retro ecw4cy: on f0970f495b web taps, notes and View spec were dead in the installed app while Hub specs passed. Root cause of the miss: fixtures served a stored snapshot with no linked computer and faked POST /api/hub-home/chat as sent; the option test called deliverHomeChat directly; the realtime chain set HARNESS_HUB_HOME_PUBLISH=1

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: No scenario joined route, connection, Mac app and Tracker in the installed config. Reusable change: shared hubHomeFixture defaults to a linked computer with no stored snapshot (chat route refuses), plus hub-home-installed-chain.spec.ts

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: loop record red at 5e632afe78 (kthwzz base): fails 'View spec shows the attached document' (GET /api/hub-home/doc 404). Same chain on clean f0970f495b and on main-based tree: tap and Other leave needs_daniel true with answer null, Tracker notes stay [], View spec 404

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Guard: hub-home-installed-chain.spec.ts plus the linked/no-stored-snapshot default in hubHomeFixture, run by packages/hub test:e2e (root check:hub). Product repairs belong to kthwzz (answers and notes over homeChat) and zt43ae (View spec over the linked connection)

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
